questions.question: Factor: 6x + 12
questions.explanation: Greatest common factor (GCF) is 6: 6x + 12 = 6(x + 2).
steps: 1. Look for the greatest common factor (GCF).

3. Factor completely and verify by multiplying back.
questions.fastStrategy: Look for common factors first, then try factoring patterns (difference of squares, trinomials).
